edits.old: 9. A defect found in the build that needs a shape change is raised against this document, and the document moves to a new minor or major version; the code never moves ahead of the document.
edits.new:
9. A defect found in the build that needs a shape change is raised against this document, and the document moves to a new minor or major version; the code never moves ahead of the document.

Term rules (GAP-2926; GAP-2927): this story owns the term start R-DIS-47 and the payment confirmation R-DIS-48 and raises the expiry signal; RWB-S5-E4024-APP owns the cancellation, the vendor score and the reopen, R-DIS-49 and R-DIS-50, so each rule row is evaluated once in rwb-decision. The legacy criteria AC2 and AC3 are kept word for word and evaluate the state gates R-DIS-11 and R-DIS-37 they name, declared once for the service; AC1 carries the term, and the duplication with the auction-round feature is recorded for the story-split review.

Term data (GAP-2925): the award, the payment due date and the payment received-at time are held against the asset_sale record, and the term length is held as versioned reference data. No column is added in this story; the buyer and the term stay placeholders of this service until the LDM or the DB story names the elements.

Consumed rows (GAP-2929): the three consumed rows and the rwb-payment payment event row carry the placeholder Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2929) and are built against their fakes until their owners publish the names.
